title: Healthy Body Look
hook: Bodies can differ and still deserve the same respect.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: friendly 3D body-learning storybook, non-graphic anatomy models and everyday wellness cues, clean shapes; visual identity: Healthy Body Look

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child learning neutral body variation
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Repair Healthy Body Look into a body-function-and-variation song: heart, muscle, joints, face traits, waist, yawn and voice are described neutrally; health is behavior/context, not appearance.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child notices normal variation and what structures do without assigning good/bad bodies, shapes, faces, dimples, or waist sizes.
